name: יִבְחָר
summary: A son of David born in Jerusalem, named after Solomon in all three lists of the sons born there (2Sa 5:14–15; 1Ch 3:5–6; 14:4–5); nothing more is told of him. The name is the qal imperfect of בָּחַר, “he chooses”, the very form of “the place which Yahweh your God יִבְחַר” (Deu 12:5) and “יִבְחַר־לָנוּ our inheritance” (Psa 47:5). The subject is not named; scripture does not explain the name.

evidence.note: “וְיִבְחָר and Elishua and Nepheg and Japhia”, among the sons born to David in Jerusalem (2Sa 5:13–14).
“The place which Yahweh your God יִבְחַר”: the same form of the verb.

note: Takes b.bg.af (the name, 3 tokens) and j.ag.ad (a zero-token cross-reference, “see בחר”). The pausal pointing יִבְחָר is the name's spelling in all three verses. Whether the subject is God (as most uses of the verb) or the parent is not said; the gloss leaves it open.
